verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Claude Design can export handoff bundles and code (HTML/CSS/JS) to Claude Code or as PPTX/PDF/HTML, but there is no mention of a layer-level 'inspect' mode giving measurements, styles, assets, and platform-specific (CSS/iOS/Android) code snippets for viewers without an editor seat — the axis is applicable to a design/dev-handoff tool but unevidenced here.
